title: Let's Learn English Lesson 14
subtitle: How About This?
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 14: How About This? (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, there! In Washington, D.C. people do many things in the evening. They go listen to music. They eat at a restaurant. They go to the theater.
dialogue.zh: 大家好！在华盛顿特区，人们晚上会做很多事。他们去听音乐。他们去餐馆吃饭。他们去看戏。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Tonight I am going to the theater with my friends. But I don’t know what clothes to wear. Maybe this magazine can help.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我要和朋友去剧院。可我不知道穿什么。也许这本杂志能帮上忙。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Her clothes are beautiful! I really want a friend like her to help me.
dialogue.zh: 她的衣服真漂亮！我真想有个像她这样的朋友来帮我。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Who are you?
dialogue.zh: 你是谁？

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: I am Genie! You want help. I am here to help you find the right clothes!
dialogue.zh: 我是精灵！你需要帮助。我来帮你找到合适的衣服！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome! How about jeans and a t-shirt?
dialogue.zh: 太好了！牛仔裤和 T 恤怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: No! Jeans and a t-shirt are too casual. How about something more formal?
dialogue.zh: 不行！牛仔裤和 T 恤太休闲了。穿正式一点的怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure!
dialogue.zh: 好啊！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow! Genie, this dress is beautiful. But it’s not the right size. It’s too small.
dialogue.zh: 哇！精灵，这件裙子很漂亮。可尺码不对。太小了。

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Yes, it is too small. But green looks great on you.
dialogue.zh: 是的，太小了。不过绿色很适合你。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Take off the green dress. Let’s try a green shirt and a skirt.
dialogue.zh: 把绿裙子脱下来。我们试试绿衬衫和裙子。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, Genie! This green shirt is too large and this orange skirt is too orange.
dialogue.zh: 哦，精灵！这件绿衬衫太大了，这条橙色裙子也太橙了。

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Yes, the right size for you is medium. Let’s try again.
dialogue.zh: 是的，你的正确尺码是中号。我们再试一次。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, I don’t like this outfit.
dialogue.zh: 哦，我不喜欢这套衣服。

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: No. That does not match.
dialogue.zh: 不行。那不搭配。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Nothing.
dialogue.zh: 什么都没有。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: These clothes are formal: a suit jacket, a dress shirt and a tie! They look great!
dialogue.zh: 这些衣服很正式：西装外套、正装衬衫和领带！看起来很棒！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Those clothes look great … for a man! Something is wrong.
dialogue.zh: 那些衣服看起来很棒……对男人来说！有点不对。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let me see.
dialogue.zh: 让我看看。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There. Now try.
dialogue.zh: 好了。现在试试。

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Oh. Thanks! Now these clothes look great on you!
dialogue.zh: 哦。谢谢！现在这些衣服穿在你身上很棒！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They do! Um, Genie, can you put on a gold belt?
dialogue.zh: 是的！嗯，精灵，你能加上一条金腰带吗？

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Sure!
dialogue.zh: 当然！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: That looks great.
dialogue.zh: 看起来很棒。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Can you put on a jacket?
dialogue.zh: 你能加上一件外套吗？

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Why not?
dialogue.zh: 为什么不呢？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love the jacket! How about a hat?
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢这件外套！帽子怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Why not?
dialogue.zh: 为什么不呢？

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Mm, take off the hat. That’s better.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，把帽子摘掉。这样更好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Genie, these clothes look and feel great! Let’s go to the theater!
dialogue.zh: 精灵，这些衣服看起来、穿起来都很棒！我们去剧院吧！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Sorry, Anna. I have to help other friends. Go to the magazine if you want me to help again.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，安娜。我还要去帮别的朋友。要是还想让我帮忙，就去找那本杂志。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Genie. Sure thing. Goodbye!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，精灵。没问题。再见！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Goodbye!
dialogue.zh: 再见！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There are many places in DC to go for a great evening out! And it’s nice to have a friend to help me look my best. Until next time! Bye!
dialogue.zh: 华盛顿特区有很多地方适合过一个美好的夜晚！有个朋友帮我打扮得漂漂亮亮，真好。下次见！再见！

quiz.prompt: Why does Genie say no to jeans and a t-shirt?
What is the right size for Anna?
